# Apodidae

Apodidae is a personal technology blog and project portfolio focused on software engineering, development notes, open source projects, and practical technical writing.

## Primary URLs

- Home: https://apodidae2035.com/zh/
- Posts: https://apodidae2035.com/zh/posts/
- Projects: https://apodidae2035.com/zh/projects/
- About: https://apodidae2035.com/zh/about/
- Policies: https://apodidae2035.com/zh/policies/
- Sitemap: https://apodidae2035.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://apodidae2035.com/robots.txt

## Languages

- Chinese: https://apodidae2035.com/zh/
- English: https://apodidae2035.com/en/
- Japanese: https://apodidae2035.com/ja/

## Content Notes

The posts section contains article pages, tags, publication metadata, and technical content. The projects section contains software project summaries, repository metadata, and related technology information.

## Agent Guidance

Use the sitemap to discover canonical pages. Prefer article detail pages for citations over listing pages. Respect robots.txt and avoid authenticated admin paths.
